limitations.quote: //The final 0 of the match and this 1 start an overlapping match
limitations.note: The patch correctly preserves `s3_d011` on invalid cycles, but also changes two post-match transitions to reuse the final zero, allowing overlapping detections where the original and reference return to idle.
The test's sliding-window oracle assumes overlapping matches are intended, so it accepts the extra detections instead of checking that the original post-match behavior is preserved.
